meta.description: Home-lab control plane - drive, connections, and more.

error.updatedTitle: Polaris was updated while this page was open
error.updatedBody: This tab is still running the old build, and the server no longer answers it. Reloading picks up the new one; anything typed into the page is lost.
error.againBody: It failed the same way again, so trying once more will not clear it. Reload to pick up a new build, or send what is below to whoever is looking at it.
error.brokeBody: The rest of Polaris is still running. Try again - and if an update landed under this tab, Polaris says so at the corner of the screen.

notFound.appTitle: This is not here any more
notFound.appDescription: It may have been removed, renamed, or never existed. Nothing else has changed - everything else is where you left it.
notFound.title: There is nothing at this address
notFound.description: The link may be out of date, or the thing it pointed at may have been removed.

share.notWritten: That share could not be written
share.notTakenBack: That share could not be taken back

mentions.unreadable: That search could not be read
mentions.lookupFailed: Those could not be looked up

terminal.untrusted: The browser would not open the connection. A terminal needs this address's certificate trusted, and accepting the warning on the page is not enough. <download>Download Polaris's certificate</download> and add it to this device's trusted roots, then reload.
